chapter_mission: Greyline hits the archive as a cleanup team, not a battlefield unit. They seal exits, wipe cameras, trigger old quarantine protocols, and try to leave no clean version of the room behind. Vara Senn appears as an attached Force specialist, making the scene psychologically unsafe. Before taking Iressa hostage, Vara engages Ben in a short, cramped lightsaber clash. Vara/Ben clash beat: Vara fights with blunt Lost Tribe aggression: pressure, fear, domination, and taunts. Ben recognizes elements of Lost Tribe training, allowing a brief Vestara Khai scar-tissue mention. The fight is short, ugly, and consequential, not a grand duel.
chapter_turn: Vara senses Iressa has hidden something.
